title: Calculate Integer Division and Remainder
question: Read two integers and display the floor-division result and remainder, handling a zero divisor.
code:
number = int(input("Number: "))
divisor = int(input("Divisor: "))
if divisor == 0:
    print("Cannot divide by zero")
else:
    print("Quotient:", number // divisor)
    print("Remainder:", number % divisor)
expected_output:
For inputs 17 and 5:
Number: 17
Divisor: 5
Quotient: 3
Remainder: 2
explanation: // performs floor division and % returns the remainder; both require a non-zero divisor.
